newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise June rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise June rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it will raise the margin requirements on its June rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Thursday.
The increase will bring total margin fees for the June contract to 72,500 yen, TOCOM said.
The rise is intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin for the May contract will remain unchanged at 97,750 yen, while margins for other contracts will stay at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
